doc.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016

title: The Thad Jones-Mel Lewis big band
summary: Rydin calls it the greatest big band and recalls its reed section; he heard it on Swedish tours.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Not really, but he had some great offers. Maybe he wanted to do something by himself. I think the big band he and Mel [Lewis] had was the greatest big band, really. At least at that time, with all those soloists. The reed section, Joe Henderson and Pepper and Jerry Dodgion and Jerome Richardson.
Amazing. Absolutely amazing. I heard this big band many times when they were touring in Sweden, but I really liked it a lot.
